# 6.303 rsInvalidSourceSeriesName

6.303 rsInvalidSourceSeriesName
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidSourceSeriesName is a critical error that will occur when a
ChartDerivedSeries.SourceChartSeriesName does not refer to the name of an existing ChartSeries
within the ChartData.ChartSeriesCollection for a Chart.
